From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops@consultants.co>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-Pillar Steering: proposed role matrix & QBR comms draft

Team —

We need a short leadership review ahead of tomorrows QBR readout. Attached are two artifacts: a proposed role matrix for the Platform Guild consolidation (PDF) and an early QBR slide with the customer-impact note (PPTX). High-level ask: please review and respond with any edits or escalations by 2pm PT so I can bake changes into the QBR deck.

Key points in the draft:
- Consolidate three platform squads into a single "Platform Guild" to reduce cross-pillar handoffs and lower path-to-prod time.
- Proposed leader slate: one Guild Lead (product/ops dual role), two stream leads (Serving Runtime, Developer Experience).
- Target rollout: announce week of Sep 27, staggered 2-week team reorgs, full transition by Nov 1.
- Customer-facing guidance: commit to unchanged SLAs and a named escalation contact during the transition.

Open questions I want feedback on:
1) Tone — is "streamline" too soft/strong? We need to balance clarity for staff with executive-level brevity.
2) Timing — is the Feb->Nov timeline reasonable given hiring cadence and Dedicated commitments?
3) PeopleOps input on severance/role mapping before announcement.

I've flagged HR/PeopleOps on the CC for headcount and employment compliance checks. If this looks good, I'll share a one-page comms memo for the broader team and a customer note we can share in early Oct.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- 20260915-platform-guild-role-matrix-v1.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
- 20260915-qbr-slide-draft.pptx (PPTX, 3 slides)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-Pillar Steering: proposed role matrix & QBR comms draft

Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear draft. A few quick notes from me:

- Tone: prefer "reduce duplication" over "consolidate" for the all-hands memo. "Consolidate" reads like a cost-cutting move; "reduce duplication" emphasizes outcomes.
- Leader slate: can we include a brief 2-sentence charter for each stream lead in the role matrix? Hiring managers want clarity on direct reports and IC ladders.
- Timing: Nov 1 final transition is tight if there are any outstanding Dedicated customer migrations in Oct. Suggest moving full transition to Nov 15 as a buffer.
- Customer comms: recommend adding a short FAQ slide addressing "what changes for customers?" and "who do I contact?".

Small editorial: in the QBR slide, the phrase "no change to SLA" should instead say "service-level commitments maintained".

I'll mark up the PDF and send comments inline unless you'd rather I create a delta doc.

— Jonas
VP, Engineering
